corrections.caveats: Enricher: run_all.py does not always average 3 runs: max_accum_time=60 stops averaging, so cells over 60 s are single runs and cells of 30-60 s get 2, which covers most Catch header and assert cells. The assert-table columns include header cost (Catch baseline 10.13 s vs doctest 3.15 s on MSVC Release before any assert). master stops at 2026-03-27 (v2.5.0), v2.5.3 was tagged 2026-07-06 and the dev branch has commits to 2026-10-18. Open issue #1168 reports Catch2 v3.7.1 and doctest 2.5.2 both at about 30 s on a real 13-file executable, and the maintainer calls the benchmarks outdated; also open: #1208 (SUBCASE in a loop, 112 s to 2420 s in 2.5.x) and #1138 (VS2026 cl 19.51+ miscompiles CHECK).

Enricher: the benchmarked 1.1.0 used a BOOST_UT_INTERFACE/IMPLEMENTATION split that is gone by v1.1.9, and standard includes grew from 7 to 25 in v2.x, so current compile cost is unmeasured. The suite gives Catch2 and doctest one TEST_CASE with 100 SECTION/SUBCASE per file but UT and GoogleTest 100 separate tests, so execution bars are not like-for-like; single-file workloads time the full doctest/Catch2 runner build while GoogleTest and Boost.Test link prebuilt libraries; one run per cell. Open #637: SEGV or skipped tests on Clang 12-16 (static-init order).
